context.transcript:
Hi, Mei Ting.
How do you like our company's new four-day workweek policy?
It's great.
I'm just as productive at work, and with three days off, I can do more things on weekends.
Like last weekend, I went to Tokyo to visit my sister.
Nice.
And it's also a good way for the company to save on energy costs.
True.
But one thing I've noticed is how cold it is in here on Monday mornings now.
They turn the heat down in all the offices on the weekend since no one is here.
Well, a lot of our co-workers bring a sweater to work.
Hmm.
I'll start doing that.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，梅婷。
你觉得我们公司新的四天工作周政策怎么样？
太棒了。
我的工作效率和以前一样，而且有三天假期，我可以在周末做更多事情。
就像上个周末，我去东京看望了我妹妹。
不错。
这对公司节省能源成本也是一个好方法。
确实。
但我注意到的是，现在周一早上这里很冷。
因为周末没人，所以所有办公室的暖气都调低了。
嗯，我们很多同事会带围巾来上班。
嗯。
我开始这样做。
